messages.author: ff3a366aa7a9b488
messages.subject: Re: Moderated mediation analysis with 2 mediators
parts:
Hi Ava, 

please think twice before relying on scores for testing moderation in SEM. Whatever is being recommended here, both the product‑indicator approach and the newer SAM framework offer measurement‑consistent ways to estimate latent interactions in lavaan. A recent BRM paper (https://link.springer.com/article/10.3758/s13428-024-02532-y) shows how to apply SAM for moderarion. If you’re testing moderation with latent variables, PI or SAM will give you a much more defensible solution.

Best, Christian
